name: Viscer Medical I
summary:
VisceR Medical I is an immersive VR clinical training experience designed for medical students, residents, and healthcare professionals. It provides a safe, repeatable environment to learn and practice essential diagnostic and procedural skills without risk to patients.

The pack includes procedures across general medicine, critical care, and obstetrics & gynaecology:

GENERAL MEDICINE & PROCEDURAL SKILLS
• Arterial Blood Gas
• Intravenous Cannula
• Chest Tube Seldinger Technique
• Thoracocentesis
• Arteria
